# CarbonCast IPTV

> CarbonCast IPTV is an open-source cross-platform IPTV player (desktop + web) that supports M3U/M3U8 playlists, Xtream Codes API, Stalker portals, and XMLTV EPG.

## Canonical URLs

- Website: https://snapwave333.github.io/carbon_cast/
- Blog: https://snapwave333.github.io/carbon_cast/blog/
- Latest Release: https://github.com/Snapwave333/carbon_cast/releases/latest
- Source Code: https://github.com/Snapwave333/carbon_cast

## Product Scope

- CarbonCast IPTV is a media player application.
- It does not provide, host, or sell playlists, channels, or media content.
- Any channel names or metadata shown in screenshots/posts are demo examples only.
